en.title: Tesla Advances Wheelchair-Accessible Cybercabs Amid Global Accessibility Push
en.summary: Tesla is developing wheelchair-accessible cybercabs to expand transportation options for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Mustang Island State Park launched free beach wheelchairs, and advocacy efforts continue with a Kendal mother's campaign against subtle discrimination and a new AA-level digital accessibility certification for a Taiwanese securities firm. Additional notes include user-reported X accessibility regressions and a report on the costs of delayed accessibility improvements.

highlights.title: Tesla is developing wheelchair-accessible cybercabs - Mashable
Mustang Island State Park offers free beach wheelchairs to improve accessibility
Kendal mum's bid to halt 'quiet' disability discrimination
Hua Nan Yong Chang Securities Achieves AA-Level Digital Accessibility Certification for Financial Inclusion
Blind user reports critical accessibility regressions in X update
The High Price of Waiting on Accessibility

zh-TW.title: Japan's Service Dog Access Law Strengthens Rights Amid Global Accessibility Advances
zh-TW.summary: 日本的服務犬法律現在規定必須允許導盲犬進入公共場所，強化對殘障人士的法律保護。同時，特斯拉推進輪椅可及的 Cybercab，穆斯坦島州立公園提供免費海灘輪椅，台灣華南永昌證券獲得 AA 級數位無障礙認證。此外，肯德爾母親反對微妙歧視的倡議持續，桃園高鐵站與殘障家庭協會合作協助出遊，以及一份報告指出延遲無障礙改善的高昂成本。
